589	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
590	pub enum Effect {

598	/// The machine for the `FileUpload` component.
599	#[derive(Debug)]
600	pub struct Machine;
601	
602	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
603	    type State = State;
604	    type Event = Event;
605	    type Context = Context;
606	    type Props = Props;
607	    type Messages = Messages;
608	    type Effect = Effect;
609	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
610	
611	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (State, Context) {
612	        let files = if let Some(files) = &props.files {
613	            Bindable::controlled(files.clone())
614	        } else {
615	            Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_files.clone())
616	        };
617	
618	        let ids = ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id);
619	
620	        (
621	            State::Idle,
622	            Context {
623	                files,
624	                rejected_files: Vec::new(),
625	                dragging: false,
626	                disabled: props.disabled,
627	                readonly: props.readonly,
628	                required: props.required,
629	                multiple: props.multiple,
630	                accept: props.accept.clone(),
631	                max_file_size: props.max_file_size,
632	                min_file_size: props.min_file_size,
633	                max_files: props.max_files,
634	                auto_upload: props.auto_upload,
635	                directory: props.directory,
636	                drag_counter: 0,
637	                focused_part: None,
638	                locale: env.locale.clone(),
639	                messages: messages.clone(),
640	                id: ids.id().to_string(),
641	                dropzone_id: ids.part("dropzone"),
642	                input_id: ids.part("input"),
643	                label_id: ids.part("label"),
644	                file_list_id: ids.part("file-list"),
645	            },
646	        )
647	    }
648	
649	    fn transition(
650	        state: &Self::State,
651	        event: &Self::Event,
652	        ctx: &Self::Context,
653	        props: &Self::Props,
654	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
655	        match event {
656	            Event::SetFiles(files) => {
657	                let files = files.clone();
658	                return Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(
659	                    move |context: &mut Context| {
660	                        if let Some(files) = files {
661	                            context.files.set(files.clone());
662	                            context.files.sync_controlled(Some(files));
663	                        } else {
664	                            context.files.sync_controlled(None);
665	                        }
666	                    },
667	                ));
668	            }
669	
670	            Event::SetProps => {
671	                return Some(TransitionPlan::context_only({
672	                    let disabled = props.disabled;
673	                    let readonly = props.readonly;
674	                    let required = props.required;
675	                    let multiple = props.multiple;
676	                    let accept = props.accept.clone();
677	                    let max_file_size = props.max_file_size;
678	                    let min_file_size = props.min_file_size;
679	                    let max_files = props.max_files;
680	                    let auto_upload = props.auto_upload;
681	                    let directory = props.directory;
682	
683	                    move |context: &mut Context| {
684	                        context.disabled = disabled;
685	                        context.readonly = readonly;
686	                        context.required = required;
687	                        context.multiple = multiple;
688	                        context.accept = accept;
689	                        context.max_file_size = max_file_size;
690	                        context.min_file_size = min_file_size;
691	                        context.max_files = max_files;
692	                        context.auto_upload = auto_upload;
693	                        context.directory = directory;
694	                    }
695	                }));
696	            }
697	
698	            Event::UploadProgress { file_id, progress } if matches!(state, State::Uploading) => {
699	                let file_id = file_id.clone();
700	                let progress = clamp_upload_fraction(*progress);
701	                return Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(
702	                    move |context: &mut Context| {
703	                        update_file_progress(context, &file_id, progress);
704	                    },
705	                ));
706	            }
707	
708	            Event::UploadComplete { file_id } if matches!(state, State::Uploading) => {
709	                let file_id = file_id.clone();
710	                let still_uploading = upload_complete_updates(ctx, &file_id);
711	                return Some(upload_finish_plan(
712	                    still_uploading,
713	                    move |context: &mut Context| {
714	                        apply_upload_complete(context, &file_id);
715	                    },
716	                ));
717	            }
718	
719	            Event::UploadError { file_id, error } if matches!(state, State::Uploading) => {
720	                let file_id = file_id.clone();
721	                let error = error.clone();
722	                let still_uploading = upload_error_updates(ctx, &file_id);
723	                return Some(upload_finish_plan(
724	                    still_uploading,
725	                    move |context: &mut Context| {
726	                        apply_upload_error(context, &file_id, &error);
727	                    },
728	                ));
729	            }
730	
731	            _ => {}
732	        }
733	
734	        if ctx.disabled || ctx.readonly {
735	            return match event {
736	                Event::Focus { part } => {
737	                    let part = *part;
738	                    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(
739	                        move |context: &mut Context| {
740	                            context.focused_part = Some(part);
741	                        },
742	                    ))
743	                }
744	
745	                Event::Blur { .. } => {
746	                    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|context: &mut Context| {
747	                        context.focused_part = None;
748	                    }))
749	                }
750	
751	                _ => None,
752	            };
753	        }
754	
755	        match (state, event) {
756	            (State::Idle, Event::DragEnter) => Some(
757	                TransitionPlan::to(State::DragOver)
758	                    .apply(|context: &mut Context| {
759	                        context.dragging = true;
760	                        context.drag_counter = 1;
761	                    })
762	                    .with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::AnnounceDropzoneActive)),
763	            ),
764	
765	            (State::DragOver, Event::DragEnter) => {
766	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|context: &mut Context| {
767	                    context.drag_counter += 1;
768	                }))
769	            }
770	
771	            (State::DragOver, Event::DragLeave) => {
772	                let new_counter = ctx.drag_counter.saturating_sub(1);
773	
774	                if new_counter == 0 {
775	                    Some(
776	                        TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(|context: &mut Context| {
777	                            context.drag_counter = 0;
778	                            context.dragging = false;
779	                        }),
780	                    )
781	                } else {
782	                    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(
783	                        move |context: &mut Context| {
784	                            context.drag_counter = new_counter;
785	                        },
786	                    ))
787	                }
788	            }
789	
790	            (State::DragOver, Event::Drop(raw_files)) => {
791	                let raw = raw_files.clone();
792	                Some(apply_selected_files_plan(
793	                    Some(State::Idle),
794	                    raw,
795	                    ctx.auto_upload,
796	                    |context: &mut Context| {
797	                        context.dragging = false;
798	                        context.drag_counter = 0;
799	                    },
800	                ))
801	            }
802	
803	            (State::Idle, Event::FilesSelected(raw_files))
804	            | (State::Uploading, Event::FilesSelected(raw_files)) => {
805	                let raw = raw_files.clone();
806	                let auto_upload = ctx.auto_upload;
807	                Some(apply_selected_files_plan(None, raw, auto_upload, |_| {}))
808	            }
809	
810	            (State::Idle, Event::StartUpload) => {
811	                if !has_pending_files(ctx, props) {
812	                    return None;
813	                }
814	
815	                Some(
816	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Uploading).apply(|context: &mut Context| {
817	                        mark_pending_as_uploading(context);
818	                    }),
819	                )
820	            }
821	
822	            (State::Uploading, Event::StartUpload) => {
823	                if !has_pending_files(ctx, props) {
824	                    return None;
825	                }
826	
827	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|context: &mut Context| {
828	                    mark_pending_as_uploading(context);
829	                }))
830	            }
831	
832	            (_, Event::RemoveFile { file_id }) => {
833	                let file_id = file_id.clone();
834	                let still_uploading = remove_file_updates(ctx, &file_id);
835	                Some(file_queue_plan(
836	                    *state,
837	                    still_uploading,
838	                    move |context: &mut Context| {
839	                        remove_file_by_id(context, &file_id);
840	                    },
841	                ))
842	            }
843	
844	            (_, Event::ClearFiles) => Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(
845	                |context: &mut Context| {
846	                    context.files.set(Vec::new());
847	                    context.rejected_files.clear();
848	                },
849	            )),
850	
851	            (_, Event::RetryFile { file_id }) => {
852	                let file_id = file_id.clone();
853	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(
854	                    move |context: &mut Context| {
855	                        retry_file_by_id(context, &file_id);
856	                    },
857	                ))
858	            }
859	
860	            (_, Event::CancelFile { file_id }) => {
861	                let file_id = file_id.clone();
862	                let still_uploading = cancel_file_updates(ctx, &file_id);
863	                Some(file_queue_plan(
864	                    *state,
865	                    still_uploading,
866	                    move |context: &mut Context| {
867	                        cancel_file_by_id(context, &file_id);
868	                    },
869	                ))
870	            }
871	
872	            (_, Event::OpenFilePicker) => Some(
873	                TransitionPlan::new().with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::OpenFilePicker)),
874	            ),
875	
876	            (_, Event::Focus { part }) => {
877	                let part = *part;
878	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(
879	                    move |context: &mut Context| {
880	                        context.focused_part = Some(part);
881	                    },
882	                ))
883	            }
884	
885	            (_, Event::Blur { .. }) => {
886	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|context: &mut Context| {
887	                    context.focused_part = None;
888	                }))
889	            }
890	
891	            _ => None,
892	        }
893	    }
894	
895	    fn on_props_changed(old: &Self::Props, new: &Self::Props) -> Vec<Self::Event> {
896	        assert_eq!(
897	            old.id, new.id,
898	            "file_upload::Props.id must remain stable after init"
899	        );
900	
901	        let mut events = Vec::new();
902	
903	        if old.files != new.files {
904	            events.push(Event::SetFiles(new.files.clone()));
905	        }
906	
907	        if old.disabled != new.disabled
908	            || old.readonly != new.readonly
909	            || old.required != new.required
910	            || old.multiple != new.multiple
911	            || old.accept != new.accept
912	            || old.max_file_size != new.max_file_size
913	            || old.min_file_size != new.min_file_size
914	            || old.max_files != new.max_files
915	            || old.auto_upload != new.auto_upload
916	            || old.directory != new.directory
917	        {
918	            events.push(Event::SetProps);
919	        }
920	
921	        events
922	    }
923	
924	    fn connect<'a>(
925	        state: &'a Self::State,
926	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
927	        props: &'a Self::Props,
928	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
929	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
930	        Api {
931	            state,
932	            ctx,
933	            props,
934	            send,
935	        }
936	    }
937	}

1342	            }
1343	
1344	            RejectionReason::CustomValidation(message) => message.clone(),
1345	        }

1412	        match part {
1413	            Part::Root => self.root_attrs(),

1415	            Part::Dropzone => self.dropzone_attrs(),
1416	            Part::Trigger => self.trigger_attrs(),
1417	            Part::ItemGroup => self.item_group_attrs(),
1418	            Part::Item { index } => self.item_attrs(index),
1419	            Part::ItemName { index } => self.item_name_attrs(index),
1420	            Part::ItemSizeText { index } => self.item_size_text_attrs(index),
1421	            Part::ItemDeleteTrigger { index } => self.item_delete_trigger_attrs(index),
1422	            Part::ItemProgress { index } => self.item_progress_attrs(index),
1423	            Part::HiddenInput => self.hidden_input_attrs(),

1428	/// Whether the maximum number of files has been reached.
1429	fn is_max_files_reached(ctx: &Context, _props: &Props) -> bool {
1430	    if let Some(max) = ctx.max_files {
1431	        ctx.files.get().len() >= max
1432	    } else {
1433	        false
1434	    }
1435	}
1436	
1437	/// Whether there are any pending files.
1438	fn has_pending_files(ctx: &Context, _props: &Props) -> bool {
1439	    ctx.files
1440	        .get()
1441	        .iter()
1442	        .any(|file| file.status == Status::Pending)
1443	}
1444	
1445	const fn item_status_token(status: &Status) -> &'static str {
1446	    match status {
1447	        Status::Pending => "pending",
1448	        Status::Uploading => "uploading",
1449	        Status::Complete => "complete",
1450	        Status::Failed(_) => "error",
1451	        Status::Cancelled => "cancelled",
1452	    }
1453	}

1455	fn format_file_size_with_locale(bytes: u64, locale: &Locale) -> String {
1456	    use alloc::format;
1457	
1458	    use ars_i18n::number::{FormatOptions, Formatter};
1459	
1460	    const KB: f64 = 1_024.0;
1461	    const MB: f64 = KB * 1_024.0;
1462	    let bytes_f = bytes as f64;
1463	
1464	    let (value, suffix) = if bytes_f >= MB {
1465	        (bytes_f / MB, "MB")
1466	    } else if bytes_f >= KB {
1467	        (bytes_f / KB, "KB")
1468	    } else {
1469	        (bytes_f, "bytes")
1470	    };
1471	
1472	    let max_fraction_digits = if suffix == "bytes" || value.fract() == 0.0 {
1473	        0
1474	    } else {
1475	        1
1476	    };
1477	
1478	    let number = Formatter::new(
1479	        locale,
1480	        FormatOptions {
1481	            max_fraction_digits,
1482	            ..FormatOptions::default()
1483	        },
1484	    )
1485	    .format(value);
1486	
1487	    format!("{number} {suffix}")
1488	}

1490	fn apply_selected_files_plan(
1491	    transition_to: Option<State>,
1492	    raw: Vec<RawFile>,
1493	    auto_upload: bool,
1494	    before: impl FnOnce(&mut Context) + 'static,
1495	) -> TransitionPlan<Machine> {
1496	    let mut plan = if let Some(state) = transition_to {
1497	        TransitionPlan::to(state)
1498	    } else {
1499	        TransitionPlan::new()
1500	    };
1501	
1502	    plan = plan.apply(move |context: &mut Context| {
1503	        before(context);
1504	
1505	        let (accepted, rejected) = validate_files(&raw, context);
1506	
1507	        context.rejected_files = rejected;
1508	
1509	        let mut current = context.files.get().clone();
1510	
1511	        current.extend(accepted);
1512	
1513	        context.files.set(current);
1514	    });
1515	
1516	    if auto_upload {
1517	        plan = plan.then(Event::StartUpload);
1518	    }
1519	
1520	    plan
1521	}

1523	fn file_queue_plan(

1527	) -> TransitionPlan<Machine> {
1528	    if matches!(state, State::Uploading) && !still_uploading {
1529	        TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(apply)
1530	    } else {
1531	        TransitionPlan::context_only(apply)
1532	    }

1715	/// Validate raw files against context constraints.
1716	fn validate_files(raw: &[RawFile], ctx: &Context) -> (Vec<Item>, Vec<Rejection>) {
1717	    let mut accepted = Vec::new();
1718	    let mut rejected = Vec::new();
1719	
1720	    let current_count = ctx.files.get().len();
1721	
1722	    for file in raw {
1723	        if !ctx.multiple && (current_count >= 1 || !accepted.is_empty()) {
1724	            rejected.push(Rejection {
1725	                name: file.name.clone(),
1726	                size: file.size,
1727	                mime_type: file.mime_type.clone(),
1728	                reason: RejectionReason::TooMany,
1729	            });
1730	
1731	            continue;
1732	        }
1733	
1734	        if let Some(max) = ctx.max_files
1735	            && current_count + accepted.len() >= max
1736	        {
1737	            rejected.push(Rejection {
1738	                name: file.name.clone(),
1739	                size: file.size,
1740	                mime_type: file.mime_type.clone(),
1741	                reason: RejectionReason::TooMany,
1742	            });
1743	
1744	            continue;
1745	        }
1746	
1747	        if !ctx.accept.is_empty() && !mime_matches(&file.mime_type, &file.name, &ctx.accept) {
1748	            rejected.push(Rejection {
1749	                name: file.name.clone(),
1750	                size: file.size,
1751	                mime_type: file.mime_type.clone(),
1752	                reason: RejectionReason::InvalidType,
1753	            });
1754	
1755	            continue;
1756	        }
1757	
1758	        if let Some(max_size) = ctx.max_file_size
1759	            && file.size > max_size
1760	        {
1761	            rejected.push(Rejection {
1762	                name: file.name.clone(),
1763	                size: file.size,
1764	                mime_type: file.mime_type.clone(),
1765	                reason: RejectionReason::TooLarge,
1766	            });
1767	
1768	            continue;
1769	        }
1770	
1771	        if let Some(min_size) = ctx.min_file_size
1772	            && file.size < min_size
1773	        {
1774	            rejected.push(Rejection {
1775	                name: file.name.clone(),
1776	                size: file.size,
1777	                mime_type: file.mime_type.clone(),
1778	                reason: RejectionReason::TooSmall,
1779	            });
1780	
1781	            continue;
1782	        }
1783	
1784	        accepted.push(Item {
1785	            id: generate_file_id(ctx, &accepted),
1786	            name: file.name.clone(),
1787	            size: file.size,
1788	            mime_type: file.mime_type.clone(),
1789	            status: Status::Pending,
1790	            progress: 0.0,
1791	            error: None,
1792	        });
1793	    }
1794	
1795	    (accepted, rejected)
1796	}
1797	
1798	fn generate_file_id(ctx: &Context, pending_accepted: &[Item]) -> String {
1799	    let max_existing = ctx
1800	        .files
1801	        .get()
1802	        .iter()
1803	        .chain(pending_accepted.iter())
1804	        .filter_map(|file| file.id.strip_prefix("file-")?.parse::<u64>().ok())
1805	        .max()
1806	        .unwrap_or(0);
1807	
1808	    format!("file-{}", max_existing.saturating_add(1))
1809	}
1810	
1811	fn mime_matches(mime: &str, name: &str, patterns: &[String]) -> bool {
1812	    let normalized = normalize_mime_type(mime);
1813	
1814	    patterns.iter().any(|pattern| {
1815	        let pattern = pattern.trim();
1816	
1817	        if pattern.ends_with("/*") {
1818	            let prefix = normalize_mime_type(&pattern[..pattern.len() - 1]);
1819	
1820	            normalized.starts_with(&prefix)
1821	        } else if let Some(extension) = pattern.strip_prefix('.') {
1822	            normalized == normalize_mime_type(pattern) || file_name_has_extension(name, extension)
1823	        } else {
1824	            normalized == normalize_mime_type(pattern)
1825	        }
1826	    })
1827	}
1828	
1829	fn normalize_mime_type(mime_type: &str) -> String {
1830	    let normalized = mime_type.trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
1831	
1832	    if normalized == "image/jpg" {
1833	        "image/jpeg".to_owned()
1834	    } else {
1835	        normalized
1836	    }
1837	}
1838	
1839	fn file_name_has_extension(name: &str, extension: &str) -> bool {
1840	    let Some(actual_extension) = name.rsplit_once('.').map(|(_, ext)| ext) else {
1841	        return false;
1842	    };
1843	
1844	    !actual_extension.is_empty() && actual_extension.eq_ignore_ascii_case(extension)
1845	}

352	### 1.6 File Validation
353	
354	```rust
355	/// Validate a set of raw files against the constraints, returning accepted and rejected.
356	fn validate_files(
357	    raw: &[RawFile],
358	    ctx: &Context,
359	) -> (Vec<Item>, Vec<Rejection>) {
360	    let mut accepted = Vec::new();
361	    let mut rejected = Vec::new();
362	    let current_count = ctx.files.get().len();
363	
364	    for (i, file) in raw.iter().enumerate() {
365	        // Check max files
366	        if let Some(max) = ctx.max_files {
367	            if current_count + accepted.len() >= max {
368	                rejected.push(Rejection {
369	                    name: file.name.clone(),
370	                    size: file.size,
371	                    mime_type: file.mime_type.clone(),
372	                    reason: RejectionReason::TooMany,
373	                });
374	                continue;
375	            }
376	        }
377	
378	        // Check MIME type
379	        if !ctx.accept.is_empty()
380	            && !mime_matches(&file.mime_type, &file.name, &ctx.accept)
381	        {
382	            rejected.push(Rejection {
383	                name: file.name.clone(),
384	                size: file.size,
385	                mime_type: file.mime_type.clone(),
386	                reason: RejectionReason::InvalidType,
387	            });
388	            continue;
389	        }
390	
391	        // Check file size
392	        if let Some(max_size) = ctx.max_file_size {
393	            if file.size > max_size {
394	                rejected.push(Rejection {
395	                    name: file.name.clone(),
396	                    size: file.size,
397	                    mime_type: file.mime_type.clone(),
398	                    reason: RejectionReason::TooLarge,
399	                });
400	                continue;
401	            }
402	        }
403	
404	        if let Some(min_size) = ctx.min_file_size {
405	            if file.size < min_size {
406	                rejected.push(Rejection {
407	                    name: file.name.clone(),
408	                    size: file.size,
409	                    mime_type: file.mime_type.clone(),
410	                    reason: RejectionReason::TooSmall,
411	                });
412	                continue;
413	            }
414	        }
415	
416	        accepted.push(Item {
417	            id: generate_file_id(),
418	            name: file.name.clone(),
419	            size: file.size,
420	            mime_type: file.mime_type.clone(),
421	            status: Status::Pending,
422	            progress: 0.0,
423	            error: None,
424	        });
425	    }
426	
427	    (accepted, rejected)
428	}
429	
430	fn mime_matches(mime: &str, name: &str, patterns: &[String]) -> bool {
431	    patterns.iter().any(|pattern| {
432	        if pattern.ends_with("/*") {
433	            let prefix = &pattern[..pattern.len() - 1];
434	            mime.starts_with(prefix)
435	        } else if pattern.starts_with('.') {
436	            name.ends_with(pattern)
437	        } else {
438	            mime == pattern
439	        }
440	    })
441	}

761	            || old.min_file_size != new.min_file_size
762	            || old.max_files != new.max_files
763	            || old.auto_upload != new.auto_upload
764	            || old.directory != new.directory
765	        {

===== adapter spec anatomy (leptos) =====
40:- Part parity: full parity with `Root`, `Label`, `Dropzone`, `Trigger`, `ItemGroup`, repeated item parts, and `HiddenInput`.
45:`Root`, `Label`, `Dropzone`, `Trigger`, `ItemGroup`, repeated `Item`, `ItemName`, `ItemSizeText`, `ItemDeleteTrigger`, `ItemProgress`, and `HiddenInput` each render as adapter-owned DOM nodes. `Dropzone` and `HiddenInput` are the two browser-API integration surfaces.
49:Dropzone button semantics, item-list semantics, item removal labels, and native file-input attrs always win. Consumer decoration must not remove `tabindex`, list semantics, or the hidden input.
57:Controlled file-list sync flows through the writable signal and `Service::set_props`, which dispatches core `SetFiles` / `SetProps` via `Machine::on_props_changed`. `Dropzone` drag events dispatch enter/leave/over/drop machine events. `Trigger` and `Dropzone` keyboard activation forward to the hidden input. Native input change events normalize `FileList` data into core `RawFile` values before validation.
65:The hidden input requires a live node for programmatic click. `Dropzone` may require a live node for focus and drag boundary handling. No consumer refs are part of the base surface.
164:`Dropzone` remains keyboard-activatable and labeled. Announcements for drops, rejections, and status changes remain additive to the visible list rather than replacing it.

> AGENT

The failure is a flawed test, not a code bug: after `SetFiles(Some(...))` the bindable becomes **controlled**, so `RemoveFile` (which only updates `internal` via `set`) doesn't change what `get()` returns — the queue isn't emptied. My test's premise was wrong. Let me replace it with a fully observable collision test that exercises the controlled→uncontrolled path (where the counter bump actually matters).

  "new_string": "#[test]\nfn file_upload_generated_ids_avoid_collision_with_controlled_ids() {\n    let mut service = Service::<Machine>::new(\n        Props::new().id(\"upload\").multiple(true),\n        &Env::default(),\n        &Messages::default(),\n    );\n\n    // Parent supplies a file in the \"file-N\" id namespace, then relinquishes\n    // control so the queue becomes uncontrolled again.\n    drop(service.send(Event::SetFiles(Some(vec![item(\n        \"file-1\",\n        \"external.png\",\n        Status::Complete,\n    )]))));\n    drop(service.send(Event::SetFiles(None)));\n\n    // User adds a file; the generated id must not collide with the supplied one\n    // because the monotonic counter was advanced past it on SetFiles.\n    drop(service.send(Event::FilesSelected(vec![raw_file(\n        \"new.png\",\n        10,\n        \"image/png\",\n    )])));\n\n    let ids: Vec<String> = service\n        .context()\n        .files\n        .get()\n        .iter()\n        .map(|file| file.id.clone())\n        .collect();\n\n    let mut unique = ids.clone();\n    unique.sort();\n    unique.dedup();\n\n    assert_eq!(\n        ids.len(),\n        unique.len(),\n        \"generated id collided with an externally supplied id: {ids:?}\"\n    );\n}"

Returns `None` when no change is required (including in DragOver,\n/// whose transient drag lifecycle is left untouched).\nfn reconciled_state(current: State, files: &[Item]) -> Option<State> {\n    let any_uploading = files.iter().any(|f| f.status == Status::Uploading);\n    match (current, any_uploading) {\n        (State::Uploading, false) => Some(State::Idle),\n        (State::Idle, true) => Some(State::Uploading),\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\nfn mime_matches(mime: &str, name: &str, patterns: &[String]) -> bool {"

> AGENT

I've fixed findings 1-5 with TDD and synced the spec. Here's the status before I commit:

## Fixed (5 of 6 findings) — TDD, no coverage regression, spec synced

| # | Sev | Fix |
|---|-----|-----|
| 1 | P1 | `capture`/`name` now stored in `Context`, populated in `init`, synced in `SetProps`, read from `ctx` in `hidden_input_attrs`, and added to `on_props_changed` detection — no more stale hidden-input attrs |
| 2 | P2 | `SetProps` resets `DragOver`→`Idle` and clears drag flags when the component becomes disabled/readonly mid-drag |
| 3 | P1 | `SetFiles` reconciles state via new `reconciled_state` helper: `Uploading`↔`Idle` follows whether the new queue has uploading items (`DragOver` untouched) |
| 4 | P1 | New monotonic `Context::next_file_id` counter — seeded in `init`, bumped on `SetFiles` past external ids, consumed+advanced in `generate_file_id`; ids never reused after removal |
| 5 | P2 | `update_file_progress` only mutates a file whose status is `Uploading` |

**Verification:** 11 new tests (all red→green), `cargo clippy --all-targets` clean, `cargo test -p ars-components --lib --features i18n` = **3626 passed / 0 failed**, `cargo xtask spec validate` passed (340 files), no snapshot drift, coverage on `file_upload/mod.rs` not regressed (the only two `^0` branches are pre-existing defensive paths I didn't add). The 7 `meter`/`progress` failures under the default feature set are pre-existing (confirmed by stashing my changes) and pass under `--features i18n`.

## Finding 6 (P2) — I disagree; need your call

Codex says: *"The anatomy places Trigger inside Dropzone, so a single trigger click bubbles to the dropzone and enqueues two `OpenFilePicker` intents."*

What the spec actually says: the anatomy (`spec/components/specialized/file-upload.md` §2) lists **Trigger and Dropzone as siblings**, not nested:
```
FileUpload
├── Dropzone   (drag-and-drop target area)
├── Trigger    (button to open file picker)
└── HiddenInput
```
My reasoning: this is the **agnostic core** (PR #301); no adapter is implemented yet. The core's `on_dropzone_click`/`on_trigger_click` have no DOM-target/bubbling information, so the core cannot detect or dedupe a bubbled click. With the spec's sibling layout there is no bubbling. If a future adapter chooses to *render* the trigger inside the dropzone, the correct fix is adapter-level `stopPropagation` — which belongs in the (not-yet-written) adapter task, and the adapter spec already notes Trigger/Dropzone as distinct surfaces. So Codex's premise contradicts the spec, and there's no clean core-level fix.

1254	### 3.3 Screen Reader Announcements
1255	
1256	The FileUpload component uses an `aria-live="polite"` region to announce file additions, rejections, and upload completions to screen reader users.
1257	
1258	For drag-and-drop state changes, a separate `aria-live="assertive"` live region is used so that screen reader users are informed of drop zone activity. See also [4.2 Drag-and-Drop Live Region Announcements](#42-drag-and-drop-live-region-announcements).
1259	
1260	The adapter MUST:
1261	
1262	1. Insert a visually-hidden `<div aria-live="assertive" aria-atomic="true">` as
1263	   a sibling of the dropzone.
1264	2. On `DragEnter` transition, set its text content to `messages.dropzone_active`.
1265	3. On `DragLeave` (when `drag_counter` reaches 0), set text to `messages.drop_zone_left`.
1266	4. On `Drop` transition, set text to `(messages.files_added)(accepted_count)`.
1267	5. Clear the live region text after a 3-second timeout to avoid stale announcements.

The convention is clear: `Effect` is a `Copy` enum of effect *kinds*; the adapter reads counts/messages from the API at handling time (`usize` payloads keep it `Copy`/`Eq`/`Hash`). Let me assess the 5 findings:

- **A** (item delete trigger inert) — contained, matches the already-applied trigger/hidden-input pattern. ✅ fix
- **C** (Delete/Backspace on item) — spec §3.2 requires it; needs a new `on_item_keydown(index, ...)` API method. ✅ fix
- **D** (compound extension `.tar.gz`) — contained validation fix. ✅ fix
- **B + E** (announcement effects for dragleave/drop/add/reject/complete) — spec §3.3/§4.2 genuinely require these; but the fix expands the public `Effect` enum and refactors the selection plan to surface counts. Real, but a deliberate API change.

  "old_string": "fn file_name_has_extension(name: &str, extension: &str) -> bool {\n    let Some(actual_extension) = name.rsplit_once('.').map(|(_, ext)| ext) else {\n        return false;\n    };\n\n    !actual_extension.is_empty() && actual_extension.eq_ignore_ascii_case(extension)\n}",
  "new_string": "fn file_name_has_extension(name: &str, extension: &str) -> bool {\n    if extension.is_empty() {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Match the full dotted suffix so compound extensions (e.g. `.tar.gz`) match\n    // `archive.tar.gz`, not just the segment after the final dot. Browser\n    // `accept` extension tokens are matched case-insensitively against the\n    // filename suffix.\n    let suffix = format!(\".{}\", extension.to_ascii_lowercase());\n\n    name.to_ascii_lowercase().ends_with(&suffix)\n}"
}

Findings A, C, D are implemented and green (99 tests, +7 new). Spec sync for those is pending (I'll bundle it). Before I implement B+E, I need your call on the approach, because they expand the adapter-facing public `Effect` enum.

## A, C, D — done (TDD green)
- **A** `item_delete_trigger_attrs` now sets `disabled` + `aria-disabled` when `disabled`/`readonly` (matches trigger/hidden-input; spec §3.1 + guard already make it inert).
- **C** new `Api::on_item_keydown(index, data)` → sends `RemoveFile` on Delete/Backspace (fulfills spec §3.2 keyboard contract).
- **D** `file_name_has_extension` now matches the full dotted suffix, so `.tar.gz` matches `archive.tar.gz`.

## B + E — announcement effect surface (need your decision)

Spec §3.3/§4.2 require live-region announcements on **dragleave** (`drop_zone_left`), **drop/select** (`files_added`), **rejections** (`rejection_message`), and **upload completion** — but the core only emits `Effect::AnnounceDropzoneActive` (on DragEnter) and `OpenFilePicker`. So adapters driven by `pending_effects` have no signal for the other announcements. The fix direction is clear (emit the missing announcement effects); the question is the API shape, since `Effect` is `Copy` and adapter-facing.

  "old_string": "/// Typed effect intents emitted by the file upload machine.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub enum Effect {\n    /// Adapter announces that the dropzone is active.\n    AnnounceDropzoneActive,\n\n    /// Adapter opens the native file picker via the hidden input.\n    OpenFilePicker,\n}",
  "new_string": "/// Typed effect intents emitted by the file upload machine.\n///\n/// Announcement variants drive the accessible live regions described in the\n/// spec (§3.3, §4.2). On each, the adapter resolves the user-facing text from\n/// the corresponding [`Messages`] field — using the carried `count` for the\n/// pluralized add/reject messages — and writes it to the live region.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub enum Effect {\n    /// Adapter announces (assertive) that the dropzone became active, via\n    /// [`Messages::dropzone_active`].\n    AnnounceDropzoneActive,\n\n    /// Adapter announces (assertive) that the dropzone is no longer active, via\n    /// [`Messages::drop_zone_left`].\n    AnnounceDropzoneLeft,\n\n    /// Adapter announces (polite) that files were added, via\n    /// [`Messages::files_added`] with `count`.\n    AnnounceFilesAdded {\n        /// Number of files accepted in this selection/drop.\n        count: usize,\n    },\n\n    /// Adapter announces (polite) that files were rejected, via\n    /// [`Messages::rejection_message`] with `count`.\n    AnnounceFilesRejected {\n        /// Number of files rejected in this selection/drop.\n        count: usize,\n    },\n\n    /// Adapter announces (polite) that an upload completed.\n    AnnounceUploadComplete,\n\n    /// Adapter opens the native file picker via the hidden input.\n    OpenFilePicker,\n}"
}

  "new_string": "fn apply_selected_files_plan(\n    transition_to: Option<State>,\n    raw: Vec<RawFile>,\n    auto_upload: bool,\n    ctx: &Context,\n    before: impl FnOnce(&mut Context) + 'static,\n) -> TransitionPlan<Machine> {\n    // Validate up front (the `before` hook only touches drag state, never the\n    // fields validation reads) so the accepted/rejected counts are known when\n    // the announcement effects are attached — effects are fixed before `apply`\n    // runs.\n    let mut next_file_id = ctx.next_file_id;\n    let (accepted, rejected) = validate_files(&raw, ctx, &mut next_file_id);\n    let accepted_count = accepted.len();\n    let rejected_count = rejected.len();\n\n    let mut plan = if let Some(state) = transition_to {\n        TransitionPlan::to(state)\n    } else {\n        TransitionPlan::new()\n    };\n\n    plan = plan.apply(move |context: &mut Context| {\n        before(context);\n\n        context.next_file_id = next_file_id;\n        context.rejected_files = rejected;\n\n        let mut current = context.files.get().clone();\n\n        current.extend(accepted);\n\n        context.files.set(current);\n    });\n\n    if accepted_count > 0 {\n        plan = plan.with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::AnnounceFilesAdded {\n            count: accepted_count,\n        }));\n    }\n\n    if rejected_count > 0 {\n        plan = plan.with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::AnnounceFilesRejected {\n            count: rejected_count,\n        }));\n    }\n\n    if auto_upload {\n        plan = plan.then(Event::StartUpload);\n    }\n\n    plan\n}"
}

  "new_string": "            Event::UploadComplete { file_id } if matches!(state, State::Uploading) => {\n                let file_id = file_id.clone();\n                // Only announce when this event actually completes a file that\n                // was still uploading (a late duplicate for a terminal file is a\n                // no-op and must stay silent).\n                let did_complete = ctx\n                    .files\n                    .get()\n                    .iter()\n                    .any(|file| file.id == file_id && file.status == Status::Uploading);\n                let still_uploading = upload_complete_updates(ctx, &file_id);\n                let plan = upload_finish_plan(still_uploading, move |context: &mut Context| {\n                    apply_upload_complete(context, &file_id);\n                });\n                return Some(if did_complete {\n                    plan.with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::AnnounceUploadComplete))\n                } else {\n                    plan\n                });\n            }"
}

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E-hgT  (db 3308033783)  crates/ars-components/src/specialized/file_upload/mod.rs:671
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Derive initial state from seeded uploading files**

When `props.files` or `default_files` already contains an item with `Status::Uploading`, the service still starts in `State::Idle`. In that initial-controlled/default queue scenario, `is_uploading()` returns false and `UploadProgress`/`UploadComplete`/`UploadError` are ignored because those transitions are guarded by `matches!(state, State::Uploading)`, leaving the visible upload stuck until some later prop sync happens to reconcile the state.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E-hgU  (db 3308033786)  crates/ars-components/src/specialized/file_upload/mod.rs:856
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Accept drag entries while uploads are active**

When at least one file is uploading, the dropzone still renders as an enabled button and `FilesSelected` explicitly supports appending more files in `State::Uploading`, but drag-and-drop cannot do the same because `DragEnter` is only handled from `Idle` and `Drop` only from `DragOver`. In that scenario, dragging another file over the dropzone never enters the drag state, so the subsequent drop is ignored and users cannot add files by drag/drop until all current uploads finish.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E-hgW  (db 3308033788)  crates/ars-components/src/specialized/file_upload/mod.rs:1881
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Let directory uploads accept all selected files**

With `directory(true)` and the default `multiple == false`, selecting a folder yields several files but this validation path accepts only the first and rejects the rest as `TooMany`. A directory upload is specifically meant to import a folder's contents, so the directory mode needs to bypass the single-file `multiple` guard (and ideally mirror that in the hidden input attrs) unless `max_files` is the limiting constraint.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E-hgY  (db 3308033790)  crates/ars-components/src/specialized/file_upload/mod.rs:1649
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Surface selected files in controlled mode**

When `Props::files` is `Some(...)`, `Bindable::get()` continues returning that controlled value after this `set`, so a user selection or drop only updates the hidden internal queue. In a controlled file-upload, selecting valid files therefore emits “files added” but `api.files()`, validation counts, and upload lifecycle still see the old controlled list, and there is no callback/effect carrying `accepted` for the parent to sync.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E-hgb  (db 3308033794)  crates/ars-components/src/specialized/file_upload/mod.rs:960
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Start uploading when retrying a failed file**

When a failed file is retried while no upload is active, this transition only mutates context and leaves the machine in `Idle`. The public API is `retry_file()`/`RetryFile`, but after the click the file is merely `Pending`; no upload state or effect starts until some separate `StartUpload` happens, so a normal retry button appears to do nothing beyond clearing the error.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Pass 5's findings have moved into design-decision territory, and several now **contradict or extend the spec** rather than being clear bugs. We're 5 Codex passes deep (each adds 5 P2 findings), so before I implement anything I want your call. Here's my spec-grounded assessment of each:

| # | Finding | Spec check | My read |
|---|---------|-----------|---------|
| **hgT** | `init` should derive state from seeded `Uploading` files | `State::Uploading` = "≥1 file uploading"; `init` returns `Idle` unconditionally → invariant violated at init | **Clear bug — fix.** (Note: this changes `init`, which invalidates my just-committed `SetFiles(None)` test setup — I'd rework that.) |
| **hgW** | `directory(true)` should bypass the `multiple==false` single-file guard | Spec lists Directory + Multiple separately; the `!multiple` guard was impl-added. A folder upload selecting 1 file is nonsensical | **Reasonable fix** — directory implies multiple-accept. |
| **hgU** | Accept drag-drop while `Uploading` | Spec §1.7 models `DragEnter` **only from `Idle`**; `FilesSelected` is explicitly dual-state but drag isn't. Adding it expands the state machine | **Scope expansion / spec change.** |
| **hgb** | `retry_file()` should auto-start the upload | Spec models `RetryFile` as **reset Failed→Pending only** (context-only, stays put); start is separate/`auto_upload` | **Contradicts spec design.** |
| **hgY** | Controlled mode needs a callback carrying `accepted` (selections only hit internal queue) | Spec §5.3 explicitly says controlled sync is "via `Bindable` reactivity… Gaps: None" — no change callback exists by design | **Contradicts spec design; biggest architectural change.** |

My recommendation: implement **hgT** (clear invariant bug) and **hgW** (directory-implies-multiple), and **push back** on **hgU/hgb/hgY** with spec-based reasoning (they change the spec's deliberate design — drag-from-Idle-only, retry-as-reset, Bindable-reactivity controlled model — and #301 is the agnostic *core*, not a redesign). If you want any of those three, it should be a deliberate spec change, ideally its own task.

===== value_change_plan helper =====
fn value_change_plan(ctx: &Context, next: State) -> TransitionPlan<Machine> {
    if *ctx.checked.get() == next {
        return TransitionPlan::context_only(|_: &mut Context| {});
    }

    if ctx.checked.is_controlled() {
        return TransitionPlan::new()
            .apply(|_: &mut Context| {})
            .with_effect(checked_change_effect(next));
    }

    TransitionPlan::to(next)
        .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
            ctx.checked.set(next);
        })
        .with_effect(checked_change_effect(next))
}

===== checked_change_effect =====
fn checked_change_effect(next: State) -> PendingEffect<Machine> {
    PendingEffect::new(
        Effect::CheckedChange,
        move |_ctx: &Context, props: &Props, _send| {
            if let Some(cb) = &props.on_checked_change {
                cb(next);
            }

            no_cleanup()
        },
    )
}

  "new_string": "/// Writes the queue, mirroring it into the controlled value when controlled.\n///\n/// In controlled mode `Bindable::get` returns the parent's value, so a bare\n/// `set` (internal-only) would leave [`Api::files`] showing the stale list. This\n/// optimistically syncs the controlled value too, so the queue is visible\n/// immediately; the parent then confirms it via [`Event::SetFiles`] (driven by\n/// the [`Effect::FilesChanged`] callback on set changes).\nfn commit_files(context: &mut Context, files: Vec<Item>) {\n    if context.files.is_controlled() {\n        context.files.sync_controlled(Some(files.clone()));\n    }\n\n    context.files.set(files);\n}\n\nfn mark_pending_as_uploading(context: &mut Context) {\n    let files = context.files.get().clone();\n\n    let updated = files\n        .into_iter()\n        .map(|mut file| {\n            if file.status == Status::Pending {\n                file.status = Status::Uploading;\n            }\n            file\n        })\n        .collect();\n\n    commit_files(context, updated);\n}"
}

fn checked_change_effect(next: State) -> PendingEffect<Machine> {
    PendingEffect::new(
        Effect::CheckedChange,
        move |_ctx: &Context, props: &Props, _send| {
            if let Some(cb) = &props.on_checked_change {
                cb(next);
            }

            no_cleanup()
        },
    )
}
    fn checkbox_checked_change_effect_is_noop_without_callback() {
        let mut service = Service::<Machine>::new(test_props(), &Env::default(), &Messages);

        let mut result = service.send(Event::Toggle);

        let effect = result.pending_effects.pop().expect("checked-change effect");
        let send: StrongSend<Event> = Arc::new(|_| {});

        drop(effect.run(service.context(), service.props(), send));

        assert_eq!(service.state(), &State::Checked);
        assert!(result.pending_effects.is_empty());
    }

Native input change events normalize `FileList` data into core `RawFile` values before validation."

  "new_string": "Controlled file-list sync flows through the writable signal and `Service::set_props`, which dispatches core `SetFiles` / `SetProps` via `Machine::on_props_changed`. The reverse direction — selections, drops, removals, and clears — surfaces through the core `FilesChanged` effect, which invokes `Props::on_files_change` with the updated queue so the controlled parent can write it back. `Dropzone` drag events dispatch enter/leave/over/drop machine events (drag-and-drop stays active during uploads). `Trigger` and `Dropzone` keyboard activation forward to the hidden input, and item-level Delete/Backspace forwards to `Api::on_item_keydown`. Native input change events normalize `FileList` data into core `RawFile` values before validation."
}

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E_RUa  (db 3308303121)  L2135
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep controlled uploads in Uploading while dragging**

When a controlled `files` prop changes to include an uploading item while the pointer is over the dropzone, `ReconcileState` hits this fallback and leaves the machine in `DragOver`. That means `is_uploading()`/`data-ars-state` stay false for an active upload, and upload progress/complete/error events are ignored because those handlers only run in `State::Uploading`; after a subsequent drag-leave the machine also transitions to `Idle` even though the queue still contains an uploading file. The reconciliation should handle `DragOver + any_uploading` by entering `Uploading` while preserving the drag flags so the existing Uploading drag-leave path can clear them.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E_RUe  (db 3308303124)  L781
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Clear drag flags when disabling during uploads**

If the component is uploading and a drag is active (`State::Uploading` with `dragging=true` from the Uploading drag-enter path), toggling `disabled` or `readonly` does not enter this reset path because it only checks `State::DragOver`. The guard immediately below then swallows the later `DragLeave`/`Drop`, leaving `data-ars-dragging` and the drag counter stuck for the rest of the disabled/read-only period; include the uploading drag context in this reset condition while preserving the upload state.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E_RUg  (db 3308303126)  L1427
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Make file items keyboard-focusable**

For the documented keyboard flow where Tab reaches file items and Delete/Backspace removes the focused item, adapters can spread these `item_attrs` and wire `on_item_keydown`, but this chain only gives the element `role="listitem"`. A plain `<li>`/listitem is skipped by sequential keyboard focus, so the item-level Delete/Backspace handler is unreachable unless each adapter adds its own focusability; add the tab/focus attribute here so the core contract works consistently.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E_RUh  (db 3308303127)  L1085
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Suppress picker effects while inert**

Because this `OpenFilePicker` arm runs before the disabled/read-only guard, calling `api.open_file_picker()` or activating the focusable dropzone while the component is disabled or read-only still emits the adapter effect that opens the native file picker. In those inert states the trigger/input are rendered disabled and selection/drop events are blocked, so the core should reject `OpenFilePicker` as well instead of asking the adapter to open UI the user cannot use.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

1425:    pub fn item_attrs(&self, index: usize) -> AttrMap {
    pub fn item_attrs(&self, index: usize) -> AttrMap {
        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Item { index }.data_attrs();

        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val).set(part_attr, part_val);

        if let Some(file) = self.ctx.files.get().get(index) {
            attrs
                .set(HtmlAttr::Role, "listitem")
                .set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-state"), item_status_token(&file.status))
                .set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-file-id"), &file.id)
                .set(
                    HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Description),
                    (self.ctx.messages.file_size)(file.size, &self.ctx.locale),
                );
        }

        attrs
    }

  "new_string": "fn reconciled_state(current: State, files: &[Item]) -> Option<State> {\n    let any_uploading = files.iter().any(|f| f.status == Status::Uploading);\n    match (current, any_uploading) {\n        (State::Uploading, false) => Some(State::Idle),\n        // Enter Uploading even from DragOver (keeping the drag flags) when a\n        // controlled queue begins an upload mid-drag, so upload events are\n        // processed and the Uploading drag-leave path can clear the flags.\n        (State::Idle | State::DragOver, true) => Some(State::Uploading),\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}"
}

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E_ku8  (db 3308413929)  L1803
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Emit controlled change after auto-upload updates status**

When `Props::files` is controlled and `auto_upload` is true, this emits `FilesChanged` with the `proposed` queue while the newly accepted files are still `Pending`, then the chained `StartUpload` immediately changes those same items to `Uploading`. Adapters run effects after the queue drains, so a controlled parent receives and writes back the stale `Pending` queue; `SetFiles`/`ReconcileState` can then return the service to `Idle`, causing subsequent progress/complete events to be ignored. The callback needs to observe the post-`StartUpload` queue, or a second controlled-change effect needs to be emitted after pending files are marked uploading.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E_ku9  (db 3308413931)  L1828
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve drag state when the last upload finishes**

If the user is dragging over the dropzone while the final active upload completes or errors, this transition moves the machine to `Idle` without clearing `dragging`/`drag_counter` or returning to `DragOver`. In that state the subsequent `DragLeave` event is ignored by the `Idle` transition table, so `data-ars-dragging` remains stuck on the root/dropzone until some unrelated event resets it. The finish path needs to account for `ctx.dragging` before choosing the target state or clear the drag flags when leaving `Uploading`.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E_ku-  (db 3308413932)  L1789
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Distinguish drop announcements from file picker selections**

Because this helper is shared by both `Event::Drop` and `Event::FilesSelected`, accepted drops emit only the generic `AnnounceFilesAdded` effect, whose contract is the polite file-addition live region. The component spec separately requires a drop to update the assertive drag-and-drop live region, but an adapter cannot tell from this effect whether the files came from DnD or the hidden input without also assertively announcing normal picker selections. Add source-specific metadata/effects so actual drops can satisfy the assertive announcement contract.

1835	/// `set` (internal-only) would leave [`Api::files`] showing the stale list. This
1836	/// optimistically syncs the controlled value too, so the queue is visible
1837	/// immediately; the parent then confirms it via [`Event::SetFiles`] (driven by
1838	/// the [`Effect::FilesChanged`] callback on set changes).
1839	fn commit_files(context: &mut Context, files: Vec<Item>) {

  "new_string": "fn file_queue_plan(\n    state: State,\n    still_uploading: bool,\n    dragging: bool,\n    apply: impl FnOnce(&mut Context) + 'static,\n) -> TransitionPlan<Machine> {\n    if matches!(state, State::Uploading) && !still_uploading {\n        TransitionPlan::to(finished_uploading_state(dragging)).apply(apply)\n    } else {\n        TransitionPlan::context_only(apply)\n    }\n}\n\nfn upload_finish_plan(\n    still_uploading: bool,\n    dragging: bool,\n    apply: impl FnOnce(&mut Context) + 'static,\n) -> TransitionPlan<Machine> {\n    if still_uploading {\n        TransitionPlan::context_only(apply)\n    } else {\n        TransitionPlan::to(finished_uploading_state(dragging)).apply(apply)\n    }\n}\n\n/// The resting state to enter when the last active upload finishes.\n///\n/// If a drag is still in progress, return to [`State::DragOver`] (preserving the\n/// drag flags) so the `DragOver` drag-leave/drop path can clear them — otherwise\n/// a `DragLeave` would be ignored by the `Idle` table and leave `data-ars-dragging`\n/// stuck. With no drag in progress, settle in [`State::Idle`].\nconst fn finished_uploading_state(dragging: bool) -> State {\n    if dragging {\n        State::DragOver\n    } else {\n        State::Idle\n    }\n}"
}

.on_files_change(move |files: Vec<Item>| {\n                captured.lock().unwrap().push(files);\n            }),\n        &Env::default(),\n        &Messages::default(),\n    );\n\n    let result =   let send: StrongSend<Event> = Arc::new(|_| {});\n    for effect in result.pending_effects {\n        if effect.name == Effect::FilesChanged {\n            drop(effect.run(service.context(),   "file_path": "/tmp/p7_ku8.md",
  "content": "Fixed in 5ad962db: `files_change_effect` no longer captures a queue snapshot at plan-build time. Its setup closure now reads `ctx.files` from the **run-time context** the adapter passes to `run()`, which is taken **after** the event queue fully drains. So for a controlled `auto_upload` selection, the `FilesChanged` callback reports the post-`StartUpload` queue (files marked `Uploading`) rather than the intermediate `Pending` snapshot — the parent writes back the correct state, and `ReconcileState` keeps the machine in `Uploading`.\n\nCovered by `file_upload_controlled_auto_upload_callback_reports_uploading_queue` (asserts the callback's queue has `Status::Uploading` after select+auto-upload).\n"
}

}

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E_0CV  (db 3308500001)  L2181
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve drag state when controlled uploads finish**

When a controlled parent replaces the queue with no `Uploading` items while a drag is active during an upload, this reconciliation moves the machine straight to `Idle` but does not clear `ctx.dragging`/`drag_counter`. The next `DragLeave` is ignored in `Idle`, so the root/dropzone can remain stuck with `data-ars-dragging` after the controlled upload completes mid-drag; this path needs the same drag-aware state choice used by upload completion.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E_0CY  (db 3308500007)  L1085
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Only auto-start uploads after a real retry**

With `auto_upload` enabled, every `RetryFile` chains `StartUpload` even when `file_id` does not identify a failed file. In that case `retry_file_by_id` leaves the queue unchanged, but any existing pending files are still moved to `Uploading`, so pressing a stale retry control or retrying a non-failed item unexpectedly starts unrelated uploads; the chained start should be conditional on actually re-queueing a failed file.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E_0Ca  (db 3308500009)  L1880
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Let controlled parents veto queue changes**

In controlled mode this optimistic `sync_controlled` makes the component keep the proposed queue even if the parent does not accept the change. Because `Service::props` still contains the old controlled `files`, a parent re-render with that same old value produces no `SetFiles` event (`old.files == new.files`), so removing/adding files can remain visible despite the controlled prop being unchanged; controlled components need a way to resync back to the prop value when the callback is ignored or vetoed.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/ericson/.t3/worktrees/ars-ui/t3code-0f770319/crates/ars-components/src/specialized/file_upload/mod.rs",
  "old_string": "            (_, Event::RetryFile { file_id }) => {\n                let file_id = file_id.clone();\n                let plan = TransitionPlan::context_only(move |context: &mut Context| {\n                    retry_file_by_id(context, &file_id);\n                });\n\n                // Mirror `FilesSelected`: when `auto_upload` is set, retrying a\n                // failed file re-queues it as `Pending` and immediately resumes\n                // uploading, so the retry control is not a silent no-op.\n                Some(if ctx.auto_upload {\n                    plan.then(Event::StartUpload)\n                } else {\n                    plan\n                })\n            }",
  "new_string": "            (_, Event::RetryFile { file_id }) => {\n                // Only re-queueing an actually-failed file should resume uploading.\n                // Otherwise a stale/duplicate retry would chain `StartUpload` and\n                // move unrelated `Pending` files to `Uploading`.\n                let will_retry = ctx\n                    .files\n                    .get()\n                    .iter()\n                    .any(|file| &file.id == file_id && matches!(file.status, Status::Failed(_)));\n                let file_id = file_id.clone();\n                let plan = TransitionPlan::context_only(move |context: &mut Context| {\n                    retry_file_by_id(context, &file_id);\n                });\n\n                // Mirror `FilesSelected`: when `auto_upload` is set, retrying a\n                // failed file re-queues it as `Pending` and immediately resumes\n                // uploading, so the retry control is not a silent no-op.\n                Some(if ctx.auto_upload && will_retry {\n                    plan.then(Event::StartUpload)\n                } else {\n                    plan\n                })\n            }"

> AGENT

0CV/0CY resolved. Now **0Ca** — per the skill this is a design fork I'm surfacing rather than deciding unilaterally, because it **reverses part of hgY** and is the third time the controlled-mode model has churned.

**The tension:** In hgY you approved surfacing controlled selections. I implemented it with `commit_files` doing an *optimistic* `sync_controlled` — so `api.files()` reflects a user action immediately. **0Ca correctly points out** that this makes the component the source of truth: if a controlled parent *vetoes* (ignores `on_files_change` and re-renders with the same old `files` prop), `on_props_changed` sees `old == new`, emits no `SetFiles`, and the component keeps showing the vetoed change.

These two goals are fundamentally contradictory:
- **hgY wanted:** `api.files()` reflects the user action immediately.
- **0Ca wants:** the parent can veto (so the component must *not* keep an unconfirmed change).

You can't have both. The standard controlled-component model (and what checkbox does here) is **parent-as-source-of-truth**.

> AGENT

I dug into the hybrid mechanism and hit a hard architectural constraint I need to flag before proceeding. The adapter's `use_machine` only calls `Service::set_props` when **props actually change** (`crates/ars-leptos/src/use_machine/mod.rs:324`: `should_sync = prev != new_props`). A veto is the parent re-rendering with the **same** `files` prop — so `set_props` is never called, `on_props_changed` never fires, and the machine has **no signal** to revert the optimistic value. 

This means a true local hybrid isn't achievable: the component can't detect "the parent declined" because a no-op veto produces no event at all. The optimistic value sticks until *some* prop changes.

So the realistic options are:

> TOOL

> AGENT

Implementing pure-controlled, I traced it through the full upload lifecycle and found it's **far larger than a local fix** — and I owe you this before churning further. The root problem: FileUpload is *stateful* (it runs the upload lifecycle), unlike checkbox. Pure-controlled requires `api.files()` to return the parent's prop. But every upload operation reads the visible queue:

- `StartUpload`/`has_pending_files`/`mark_pending` read `get()` → in controlled mode that's the parent's prop, **not** the files the user just selected. So `auto_upload` + controlled no-ops (the chained `StartUpload` runs before the parent adopts, finds nothing).
- `UploadProgress`/`Complete`/`Error` write `internal`, but `get()` returns the controlled prop → progress is invisible until the parent re-adopts.

To make pure-controlled actually work, **every** file-touching transition (select, drop, remove, clear, **and every status change**) would have to emit `on_files_change` and have the parent round-trip it back through `SetFiles`. That's a foundational rework of the whole machine, well beyond a review-loop fix — and it changes `auto_upload`/progress semantics in controlled mode.

The two coherent end-states are:

> TOOL

So the fix is **reframing the misleading "optimistic/parent-confirms" docs** to state the component-owns-queue contract, plus the reply — no functional change (tests already assert this behavior). {
  "file_path": "/tmp/p8_0Ca.md",
  "content": "After discussing with the maintainer, we've settled the controlled-mode model explicitly: **`FileUpload` owns its working upload queue** — `api.files()` and the entire upload lifecycle (start/progress/complete/cancel/retry) read it in both controlled and uncontrolled mode, as in `react-dropzone` and similar libraries. The controlled `files` prop is a **seed/sync** source (applied at `init` and via `Event::SetFiles` when the prop changes), and `on_files_change` is an **observation** hook so the parent can mirror/persist the queue.\n\nSo a mid-flight *veto* of the working queue is intentionally **not** supported in this model — that would require the parent to be the sole source of truth for the set *and* every upload status, round-tripping each progress tick through the prop, which doesn't fit a component that runs the upload lifecycle. A controlled parent that wants a different set re-asserts it by changing the `files` prop (→ `SetFiles` reseeds the queue).\n\nClarified in 8a8804ab: reframed the `commit_files` / `on_files_change` / `FilesChanged` docs (and the spec) to state this contract — the controlled mirror exists only so `Bindable::get` returns the working queue. No behavior change. Resolving as working-as-designed.\n"
}

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E__az  (db 3308563986)  L1069
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve drag state when clearing uploads**

When `clear_files()` is called while an upload is active and a drag is over the dropzone (`State::Uploading` with `ctx.dragging == true`), this always transitions to `Idle` without clearing `dragging`/`drag_counter`. The next `DragLeave` is then ignored by the `Idle` transition table, so `data-ars-dragging` can remain stuck after clearing the queue mid-drag; this needs the same drag-aware state choice or flag reset used by the upload-finish paths.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6E__a3  (db 3308563990)  L1835
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Only auto-start after accepted selections**

Because `StartUpload` is chained whenever `auto_upload` is true, a selection/drop with zero accepted files still starts any unrelated `Pending` files already in the queue. For example, if a pending file exists and the user then selects only rejected files (invalid type, too many, or an empty/cancelled picker result), this path moves the old pending file to `Uploading`; gate the chained start on `accepted_count > 0` so auto-upload is tied to a real accepted selection/drop.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6FAYpo  (db 3308706905)  L1069
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve drag state when clearing files**

When `clear_files()` is dispatched while a drag is active (for example during `DragOver`, or during `Uploading` after `DragEnter`), this transition forces the machine to `Idle` but leaves `ctx.dragging` and `ctx.drag_counter` unchanged. The following `DragLeave` is then ignored by the `Idle` transition table, so `root_attrs()`/`dropzone_attrs()` keep emitting `data-ars-dragging` indefinitely; this is the same stranded-drag scenario handled in the upload-finish paths. Either clear the drag flags here or settle through `finished_uploading_state(ctx.dragging)`/`DragOver` so the drag lifecycle can complete.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6FAYpq  (db 3308706910)  L1835
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Gate auto-upload on accepted files**

With `auto_upload` enabled, this always queues `StartUpload` even when validation accepted zero files. If there is already a pending file in the queue and the user selects or drops only rejected files (wrong type, too large, etc.), the failed selection unexpectedly starts uploading the older pending file; only chain `StartUpload` when `accepted_count > 0`.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

### PRRT_kwDORp4enM6FAYpt  (db 3308706914)  L1592
**<sub><sub>![P3 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P3-lightgrey?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid formatting stale size limits as zero**

If a file is rejected for `TooLarge` and then the parent clears or changes `max_file_size` before the UI renders `validation_error_text`, this formats the old rejection with the current prop (or `0` when it is now `None`), producing messages like “maximum size of 0 bytes.” The same stale-prop pattern exists for `TooSmall`; either store the applicable limit in the rejection or clear/recompute rejections when validation props change.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
